lists.name: CareOps Process Checkpoints
lists.purpose: One bounded checkpoint per approved source partition
lists.lookup: Get items with Filter Query source_key eq '<source_key>' and Top Count 2; create the empty revision-zero row when none exists, use the returned ID when exactly one exists, and stop if two rows are returned
lists.source_key_format: keyed lowercase hexadecimal reference without OData metacharacters

columns.source_key: single-line text, required, unique, keyed partition reference
columns.last_error_code: single-line text, nullable, fixed reason code

lists.access: single configured flow-owner writer; authorized operators read as needed

lists.name: CareOps Process Event Queue
lists.purpose: Modest retry and identity ledger before portable event-file publication

columns.fact_id: single-line text, required, unique, existing keyed pseudonymous fact ID
columns.activity: single-line text, required, allowlisted event code
columns.object_ids: multi-line text, required, bounded JSON array of pseudonymous IDs
columns.folder_ref: single-line text, required for Outlook partitions, keyed pseudonymous folder reference

lists.retention: bounded by the approved replay horizon; preserve tombstoned identities until the horizon expires

lists.name: CareOps Process Dead Letters
lists.purpose: Minimized recovery evidence; never a source payload archive

columns.dead_letter_key: single-line text, required, unique, deterministic keyed reference
columns.fact_id: single-line text, required, keyed pseudonymous fact ID
columns.reason_code: single-line text, required, fixed reason code

lists.retention: approved minimal audit and recovery period

flow_safety.uncertain_create: read back exact unique fact_id and compare all minimized fields before retry or watermark advancement
flow_safety.checkpoint_conflict: stop; re-read and reconcile; never replace a newer revision
flow_safety.pseudonymization: reuse the existing HMAC-SHA256 keyed pseudonymization contract; until an exact supported standard-connector invocation is verified, do not write source facts or identifiers
flow_safety.planner_boundary: use only selected standard Planner task metadata; defer unsupported plans, identities or pagination rather than request broader access
flow_safety.native_execution: requires exact approved environment, site, list IDs, connection references, owner and readback evidence
